Phoenix to Tucson shuttle, private and chauffeured

Scottsdale Sprinters runs a private Phoenix to Tucson shuttle: one chauffeured vehicle for your group, door to door from Phoenix, Scottsdale or Sky Harbor, and the same ride from Tucson to Phoenix. If checkout measures the drive at 2 hours each way, one way is $600 before 8% tax in the Luxury SUV (Suburban) for up to 6, or $730 in an Executive Sprinter for up to 14. Questions? Call (623) 986-6339 or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Last updated: October 6, 2026

How do you get from Phoenix to Tucson without driving?

Book a private chauffeured transfer down Interstate 10: one vehicle for your group alone, from any Phoenix or Scottsdale address, Sky Harbor included, to your door in Tucson. In the Luxury SUV (Suburban), for up to 6 with 10 bags, one way is $600 before 8% tax when checkout measures the drive at 2 hours each way. It is not a shared shuttle: no strangers’ stops, no timetable, and one price for the whole vehicle however many of you ride. I-10 has run three lanes in each direction between Casa Grande and Tucson since 2019, ADOT says, and its Wild Horse Pass Corridor Project is adding a third lane each way on the 26 miles from Loop 202 to just north of Casa Grande; as of October 6, 2026, ADOT schedules completion for late 2029.

How far is Tucson from Phoenix, and how long is the drive?

From Old Town Scottsdale: about 115 miles by road to downtown Tucson, about 1¾ to 2¼ hours each way without stops or traffic delays. From Phoenix Sky Harbor: about 110 miles by road to downtown Tucson, about 1¾ to 2 hours each way without stops or traffic delays. Your chauffeur plans the route; the checkout measures your own two addresses and prices from that drive. If anyone needs a break, Sacaton, between mileposts 181 and 184, is the only state-run rest area between Phoenix and Tucson, ADOT says, and Picacho Peak State Park sits beside the road at exit 219, its 1,500-foot peak in plain view. An added stop on a transfer is $50.

How much is a private shuttle from Phoenix to Tucson?

The Tucson run is priced as a transfer, for the vehicle and not by the seat. At a drive of 2 hours each way, one way before tax is $600 in the Luxury SUV (Suburban), $730 in the Executive Black Sprinter and $1,225 in the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax); there and back booked together is $1,080, $1,314 and $2,205. A transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and priced from the drive beyond that, with the empty return included. The transfer basis covers the first 60 minutes of the vehicle’s time, out and back empty, and every 30 minutes past that, rounded up, is billed at the vehicle’s hourly rate, so a drive of 2 hours each way adds 3 hours at $125 an hour in the Luxury SUV (Suburban). Checkout measures your two addresses and shows the total before you pay. Luxury SUV (Suburban), for 6 riders and 10 bags: $600 south, $1,080 there and back, about $100 a rider with every seat taken. Executive Black Sprinter, for 14 riders and 40 bags: $730 south, $1,314 there and back, about $52 a rider with every seat taken. Executive White Sprinter, for 14 riders and 40 bags: $730 south, $1,314 there and back, about $52 a rider with every seat taken. Maybach Jet Sprinter, for 9 riders and 4 bags: $1,435 south, $2,583 there and back, about $159 a rider with every seat taken. Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax), for 29 riders and 30 bags: $1,225 south, $2,205 there and back, about $42 a rider with every seat taken. 56-Passenger Motorcoach, for 56 riders and 125 bags: $2,225 south, $4,005 there and back, about $40 a rider with every seat taken.

Is there a Tucson to Phoenix shuttle for the ride back?

Yes, the same private ride north: we collect at your Tucson address, a home, a hotel or the University of Arizona campus at 1200 E University Blvd, and drive you to Phoenix, Scottsdale or your terminal at Sky Harbor, priced from the measured drive. Book the ride south and the ride back together and the return comes off 20%; the pickup address and time are confirmed in writing before you pay. A pickup at Tucson International Airport (TUS), about 8 miles south of downtown, is different: the Tucson Airport Authority requires a permit for every commercial vehicle that picks up passengers there and allows those pickups only on the airport’s commercial roadway, so ask the reservations desk whether a TUS pickup can be arranged before you plan on one.

Which Saguaro National Park roads suit a larger vehicle?

Both scenic loops limit size: on Cactus Forest Drive in the east district and Bajada Loop Drive in the west, the park prohibits vehicles wider than 8.5 feet and towed combinations 40 feet or longer. Cactus Forest Drive is a paved 8-mile loop with no parking for RVs and larger vehicles; Bajada Loop Drive is a 6-mile graded dirt road. Saguaro East, the Rincon Mountain District, is at 3693 S. Old Spanish Trail, reached from I-10 exit 275 by Houghton Road and Escalante Road. Saguaro West, the Tucson Mountain District, is at 2700 N. Kinney Road, and the park lists three ways there: from I-10 exit 242 by Avra Valley Road and Sandario Road; from central Tucson west on Speedway Boulevard over Gates Pass, where the park notes a 12,000-pound vehicle weight limit and that vehicles over 25 feet are not recommended; and from I-19 by Ajo Way, State Route 86, and Kinney Road. Neither loop has RV parking, and every visit needs an entrance pass, its type set by how you arrive.

Can a group get into Sabino Canyon or up Mount Lemmon?

Sabino Canyon has been closed to private vehicles since 1978, the Forest Service says; from the visitor area at 5700 N. Sabino Canyon Road, visitors ride the open-air Sabino Canyon Crawler or the Bear Canyon shuttle. Parking there needs a recreation pass on the dashboard, and the lot can be crowded in fall, winter and spring, with an overflow gravel lot just past the entrance. Mount Lemmon is reached by the Catalina Highway off Tanque Verde Road, which becomes the Hitchcock Highway at the forest boundary: 27 miles the Forest Service likens to driving from the deserts of Mexico to the forests of Canada, up to an elevation of about 9,000 feet. The road beyond Mt. Lemmon Ski Valley closes in winter, and the Pima County Sheriff’s road condition hotline has the day’s conditions. On an hourly day the vehicle and chauffeur wait while you ride the Crawler or walk the mountain; on a transfer the vehicle drops you and leaves.

Which Tucson dates should a group plan around?

The Territorial Cup, Arizona State at Arizona, is on Saturday, November 28, 2026, in Tucson; our Territorial Cup page covers that game day. Visit Tucson lists the citywide Tucson Gem, Mineral & Fossil Showcase from January 27 to February 14, 2027: over 4,000 exhibitors and buyers at more than 40 locations across the city. The 72nd Tucson Gem and Mineral Show runs February 11 to 14, 2027, at the Tucson Convention Center, 260 S. Church Avenue. The University of Arizona’s 2027 Commencement is set for Friday, May 14, at 7:30 p.m. at Casino Del Sol Stadium, subject to change: guests need no ticket, the gates open at 6:00 p.m., parking is free in University lots and garages, and golf carts run from the 6th Street Garage to Gate 8 and from the Cherry Garage to Gate 6. For any of them, tell the reservations desk the event, the address and the time you need to arrive; the confirmation sets the pickup in writing.

Which vehicle should we book for Tucson?

Count bags as well as people. The lowest fare on this page is the Luxury SUV (Suburban)’s, for up to 6 riders and 10 bags. A student moving in or out with family, or buyers bringing gem show purchases home, will want the cargo of an Executive Sprinter, black or white: 14 seats and room for 40 bags. A wedding party or a company retreat at a Tucson resort rides the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax), 29 seats and 30 bags, or the 56-Passenger Motorcoach, 56 seats and 125 bags. The Maybach Jet Sprinter seats 9, four of them massage and reclining seats in Maybach leather, with room for 4 checked bags.

Can we go to Tucson and back in one day?

Yes. Book the vehicle by the hour instead of as a transfer and it stays with your group in Tucson, stops included: $1,015 for eight hours in an Executive Sprinter, or $875 in the Luxury SUV (Suburban), before tax. Hourly bookings of 7 hours or longer get free hours taken off at checkout, so an eight-hour day bills 7 hours.

What does the Tucson fare include?

The fare covers the chauffeur, the fuel and bottled water. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout, with no booking fee, no service charge and no fuel surcharge; gratuity is optional. Deposit, balance and cancellation terms are set out on our policies page. Adults 21 and over may carry their own drinks on a for-hire vehicle under Arizona law, but if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on the trip. The chauffeur never drinks, and no one smokes or vapes on board.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a shuttle cost from Phoenix to Tucson?

It is priced per vehicle from the measured drive: at 2 hours each way, the Luxury SUV (Suburban), for up to 6, is $600 one way before tax, and an Executive Sprinter, for up to 14, is $730. Your own two addresses set the exact total, shown before you pay.

Is there an airport shuttle from Phoenix Sky Harbor to Tucson?

Yes, private, from your terminal. Scottsdale Sprinters holds the Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX) ground transportation permit. Send the airline and flight number with the booking: the confirmation sets out the pickup method and the meeting point, and your chauffeur sends the pickup instruction after you land.

Is there a Phoenix to Tucson shuttle schedule?

No timetable. A private transfer leaves at the time you book, from the address you give, and costs the same for the vehicle whether two ride or the cabin is full.

Can you pick us up at Tucson International Airport?

Ask before you book. The Tucson Airport Authority requires a permit for any commercial vehicle picking up passengers at TUS and allows those pickups only on its commercial roadway, so the reservations desk confirms whether a TUS pickup can be arranged for your date.

Is there a shuttle from Tucson to Phoenix Sky Harbor?

Yes, a private one: give us your Tucson address and your flight time, and the chauffeur takes you to your Sky Harbor terminal at the price of the measured drive, confirmed in writing before you pay.

When is the Tucson Gem and Mineral Show in 2027?

February 11 to 14, 2027, at the Tucson Convention Center, 260 S. Church Avenue, the Tucson Gem and Mineral Society says; the citywide gem showcase around it runs January 27 to February 14, 2027.
